text:
Type: smoky brown glass vase
Use: holding single stems or a few branches on a table or shelf; living room, dining room, bedroom
Style: contemporary, Scandinavian, minimalist
Materials: tinted smoked glass with an organic, slightly irregular surface
Colors: smoky grey-brown, translucent
Shape: tall organic teardrop body that narrows into a long neck with a slanted flared lip, slightly lopsided handmade-looking silhouette, slender and light
Feel: soft, organic, calm
Goes with: oak or walnut, linen, dried grasses, warm neutrals; Japandi, Scandinavian or contemporary rooms

product.name: VRVIND
product.description: Use the vase with flowers or alone, as a beautiful object in its own right.
